name: zinput_joystick_shutdown_device
description: zInput::Joystick_ShutdownDevice unacquires and releases the global joystick DirectInput device when present, clears the global device pointer, and returns success.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x472280 returns 1 on the null-device path. For a non-null global joystick device, it calls the provider vtable Unacquire slot 0x20, reloads the global, calls Release slot 0x08, clears g_zInput_JoystickDevice, and returns 1.
Native smoke zinput_joystick_shutdown_device_smoke verifies the null-device no-call path, the non-null Unacquire and Release calls, the success return value, and clearing g_zInput_JoystickDevice.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x472280 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput joystick shutdown pass.
